== Sounio ==

{{works with|Sounio|v1.0.0-beta.6}}

<lang sounio>fn bubble_sort(arr: &![i64; 8], n: i64) with Mut, Panic {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n - 1 {
        var j: i64 = 0
        while j < n - i - 1 {
            if arr[j] > arr[j + 1] {
                let temp = arr[j]
                arr[j] = arr[j + 1]
                arr[j + 1] = temp
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var arr: [i64; 8] = [64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90, 1]
    bubble_sort(&!arr, 8)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 8 {
        print(arr[i])
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    println("")
}</lang>

Output:
<pre>1 11 12 22 25 34 64 90</pre>

Note: Sounio uses <code>&!T</code> (exclusive reference) where other languages use <code>&mut T</code> or pass by reference. The <code>Panic</code> effect is required for array indexing.
